page.overview:
Who is Barlow?

Barlow was a male Human Imperial officer who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he held the rank of lieutenant colonel and was based at the Imperial Fortress on Yavin 4.

Barlow appeared as a non-player character in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, Lieutenant Colonel Barlow was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack Jump to Lightspeed on October 27, 2004.
